blocks.x: If the fall has you eager to plan a cozy getaway, you’ll be happy to know that traveling doesn’t always have to cost an arm and a leg. Hotels.com coupons are one way to save: Travelers can find discounts on luxury villas, storybook cottages, romantic cabins, and all-inclusive resorts for their next getaway. Whether you’re planning a weekend in Las Vegas or a two-week trek across Italy, there is an accommodation waiting for you on the booking platform.

In addition to over 100,000 hotels, Hotels.com—similar to brands like Priceline, Trip.com, and Booking.com—offers car rentals with impressively low rates. You’ll be riding in style—and comfort—in the newest makes and models on the market. Plus, you save more when you’re part of the club—by joining the Hotels.com rewards program, guests can rack up OneKeyCash to save on future hotels and rentals.
Save up to 30% in the Fall Sale

Still don't have end-of-year travel plans? Hotels.com has plenty of inspiration—and deals to help you get there while staying within your budget. Right now, you can check the deals page to find hotel discounts of up to 30% on stays at thousands of hotels around the world, from London to Las Vegas. Family-friendly fun calling your name? You can get a $2,459 discount on a seven-night stay at Nickelodeon Hotels & Resorts Riviera Maya right now. More of an adults-only person? Snag eight nights at Excellence Punta Cana for around 30% off.
Get 10% off with a Hotels.com sign-up discount

Travelers can create a free account for Hotels.com Rewards and save 10% or more on over 350,000 stays worldwide after signing up. After each booking, travelers will also earn OneKeyCash to use on future hotel stays and car rentals booked through Hotels.com, Expedia, or Vrbo (members receive 2% in OneKeyCash for every dollar spent on eligible hotels, vacation rentals, activities, packages, car rentals, and cruises). And the more you stay, the more you earn, as you get more benefits as you move through the tiers (Blue being the lowest, Platinum being the highest). More information on the tiers, below:

VIP support

Redeeming your OneKeyCash is simple—every $1 in OneCash becomes a $​1 discount on future travel. While there are a ton of lovely budget options to choose from, members who book VIP Access properties earn up to 6% in OneKeyCash, and Platinum status holders save up to 20%.
Save extra on Hotels.com bookings without a coupon

We’ve all waited a bit too long to book a hotel or flight, only to find out that when we’re finally ready to book, prices have skyrocketed and it’s now out of budget. To make the price more digestible, Hotels.com now offers pay-over-time payment plans through Affirm for approved guests. You’ll be able to choose the repayment plan that makes the most sense for you and then pay on your own time. With over 100,000 accommodations to choose from, Hotels.com features properties at a variety of price points, so while there are rooms from the most sought-after hotels in the world available, you’ll also find comfortable stays under $100 a night.

In addition to flexible payment, Hotels.com offers flexibility when it comes to bookings. There are a ton of hotels to choose from that allow you to make changes or cancel your booking—free of charge—up to 24 hours before check-in with a full refund guaranteed. While there are numerous hotels that offer flexible bookings, we recommend double-checking the hotel’s exact cancellation window on the home page.
Get discounts on last-minute weekend breaks

If you want to get out of town for a little bit and are down for a last-minute weekend break, the Hotels.com fall sale has you covered. Check the deals page for special pricing on quick stays booked without much time to spare—typically for travel within the same month of booking. For example, right now you can snag $796 off a three-night stay at Hotel Riu Plaza New York Times Square in October—the perfect time to be in the Big Apple.
Our favorite Hotels.com destinations

Hotels.com opens up discounted stays across the world to travelers. Each year our editors and contributors compile a list of the Best Places to Go, based on a bevy of factors: entertainment travel, cultural events, and new hotel openings included. This year’s iteration includes Alaska, Tunisia, Nicaragua, and Denver, just to name a few. If you didn't get enough beach time this summer, you're probably desperate for some vitamin sea—luckily, Miami, Puerto Rico, and Cape Town have plenty of sunshine and sand to spare.
What to do if your Hotels.com coupon isn’t working

If your Hotels.com coupon code isn't working—don't panic. There are a few things to check to ensure everyone goes smoothly. I recommend starting by ensuring that the code is still valid, and that expiration dates, minimum spend requirements, and product exclusions all apply. If everything looks correct, try clearing your browser’s cache and cookies, or switching devices or browsers.
